period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (as published in UCB's own annual report's 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financial Statements by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure, not a discrete-quarter figure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK. net_profit_after_tax_cumulative is recorded as 1,058.69 (BDT million), not the 4,058.69 printed in FY2013's own report table -- a digit-extraction error in that source. The FY2014 annual report's comparative column for the identical period (1 Jan-30 Jun 2013) independently shows 1,058.69, and this is also the only value consistent with the balance-sheet roll-forward: shareholders' equity moved from 17,000.04 (Q1-2013) to 18,152.28 (Q2-2013), a change of +1,152.24m, which reconciles with a cumulative profit of +1,058.69m plus a small non-P&L equity movement -- a +4,058.69m profit would imply an unexplained ~-2,900m of other equity movement in the same quarter, which has no support elsewhere in either report. nav_per_share (21.70) was NOT affected by the Q1/Q3 column-transposition described in the Q1 file's note (the 2nd-quarter columns are correctly placed in FY2013's own table) and is confirmed exactly by the FY2014 report's comparative column. All other line items matched exactly between FY2013's own table and FY2014's comparative column.
